nodes.label: Buildkite authorization scope
nodes.rationale: The extension grants no access beyond Buildkite's own authorization decisions.

nodes.label: Auto refresh and manual refresh
nodes.rationale: Refresh every 60 seconds only while the view is visible; response data stays in memory only.

nodes.label: Environment variable masking
nodes.rationale: Env values are sensitive by default; used for one request only and discarded afterwards.

nodes.label: My Pipelines
nodes.rationale: Lists only authorized pipelines; 50 per page alphabetically with search and Load more.

nodes.label: Origin remote project matching
nodes.rationale: Only the selected folder origin remote is used; a unique match is required and there is no manual override.

nodes.label: Token storage and replacement
nodes.rationale: Token is a secret: stored only in encrypted secret storage, never displayed or logged.

nodes.label: Trigger build flow
nodes.rationale: Triggering requires explicit confirmation showing pipeline, branch or commit and message with environment values masked.

nodes.label: Build page editor tab
nodes.rationale: Build details moved out of cramped nested tree rows into a readable single reused editor tab.

nodes.label: Build status icons and colours
nodes.rationale: Status icons follow the theme so users can see at a glance whether builds pass.

nodes.label: Quick trigger from Current project
nodes.rationale: Skips pipeline selection and pre-fills the current Git branch so users do not retype it.

nodes.label: Buildkite VS Code extension spec
nodes.rationale: Developers need CI context inside VS Code and a safe way to browse and trigger only authorized pipelines without leaking the token.

nodes.label: Sidebar and build page redesign spec
nodes.norm_label: sidebar and build page redesign spec
nodes.rationale: The tree is hard to read: plain text, no icons, bare build states, raw ISO timestamps and setup steps mixed with rows.

nodes.label: Security model
nodes.rationale: Token and trigger environment values must never leak into settings, files, logs, telemetry or diagnostics.
